_describes: Offline cassette for refresh_references.py --fixture mode. Lets smoke exercise the doi -> pmid -> docsum -> citation-string path without network. Two PMID DocSums are real (Manichaikul 2010 + Korneliussen 2014, KING + ANGSD) — the rest of references.jsonl skips gracefully because the doi/pmid is absent from this cassette. Add new entries here when you want smoke to cover more rows.
